about_the_game:
​​Game Synopsis​​

Ms Vampire Love to Date with Me Demo is an ADV simulation game where players control Tang Jun, the protagonist, as he lives together with Irene, a girl claiming to be his girlfriend, in a castle for the first fifteen days of their supposed thirty-day cohabitation. Although the protagonist has no recollection of Irene whatsoever, she adamantly insists they are in a romantic relationship. Players must interact with her to maintain her emotional and physical stability, while seizing opportunities to uncover the truth Irene has hidden.

​​In the Demo Version​​

  • You can develop Irene's attributes. As with the full version, when a corresponding attribute reaches 50, Advanced Training and Level 2 Dates become available. When an attribute reaches 120, Level 3 Dates unlock.

  • After reaching 1000 Bond, blood-sucking can lead to deeper interactions with Irene.

  • If you avoid a Bad Ending, you will automatically return to the title screen after 15 days.

  • The demo only includes Streamer Mode. Some CGs have been revised. The Complete Mode will be unlocked in the full version.

content_descriptors.notes: Some game CG is relatively nude and sexy, but it does not reveal sensitive padding
